title: Unique Registry

story.briefing: Two outposts kept separate registries through the outage. Only the nodes that both of them recorded can be trusted.
story.success: Registries reconciled. The trusted set is small, but it is certain.

description: Given two arrays of node identifiers, return the identifiers that appear in both, sorted in increasing order, with no repeats. If nothing appears in both, return an empty array.
hints: Membership testing is the core operation, and a structure built for membership answers it far faster than a repeated scan.
Two separate requirements hide here: no repeats in the output, and sorted order. Handle them deliberately rather than hoping the input order helps.
Put the first array into a set. Walk the second array collecting values the set contains, into a second set to remove repeats. Convert that to an array and sort it numerically.
